bear_assumptions: Apply 25x the USD 6.65 low end of 2026 adjusted EPS guidance as growth and margin expectations normalize, backlog conversion slows, congestion or project phasing persists, working capital absorbs cash, and the premium multiple compresses.
base_assumptions: Adjusted EPS grows 20% from the USD 6.70 guidance midpoint to USD 8.04 and retains a premium 35x multiple as AI-infrastructure demand, capacity, margins and cash conversion continue but decelerate from exceptional 2026 growth.
bull_assumptions: Adjusted EPS reaches USD 10.05 and earns a 40x multiple as liquid cooling, capacity additions, backlog conversion, pricing, productivity and cash conversion all remain exceptional without material dilution or execution setbacks.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if price or higher primary-evidence earnings make expected return, base return, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin of safety, confidence and an accepted relationship clear every canonical gate; downgrade if organic growth and backlog conversion weaken together, margin expansion reverses, cash conversion persistently trails earnings, working capital deteriorates, or capacity and product execution fail.
